Nothing in the HLSL front end\0A// does, which is what this issue is asking for.\0A//\0A// Careful when searching the DXC panes: Compiler Explorer compiles with debug info,\0A// so this banner is embedded verbatim in the shader's own !dx.source.contents\0A// metadata. Any operation name written here would be findable in the pane text\0A// without the compiler having emitted anything of the sort. That is why the op\0A// class name is not spelled out above; see the issue comment for it.\0A//\0A// The multiply half of the request is absent from this file because FXC has no\0A// 64-bit integers. In DXC the high 32 bits of a 32x32 multiply can only be reached\0A// by widening to uint64_t, which adds the optional 64-bit integer feature to the\0A// shader.\0A//==========================================================================//\0A\0ARWStructuredBuffer<uint4> Out : register(u0);\0A\0A[numthreads(1, 1, 1)]\0Avoid main(uint3 tid : SV_DispatchThreadID) {\0A  uint a = Out[tid.x].x;\0A  uint b = Out[tid.x].y;\0A  Out[tid.x] = uint4(a / b, a % b, 0, 0);\0A}\0A"}
